name: windows-mcp
description: Fast Windows desktop control through CursorTouch Windows-MCP

interface.shortDescription: Control Windows apps with screenshots, UI state, mouse, and keyboard.
interface.longDescription: Makes CursorTouch Windows-MCP the primary local Windows-control mechanism and requires visual verification after UI actions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Windows-MCP to complete the requested Windows desktop task and visually verify every state change.
